svg.title: Four graphs with the x-axis marked into falling and rising stretches: (a) the even graph through (-4,2), (-3,0), (0,3), (3,0), (4,2); (b) the odd curve with turning points (-2,-1) and (2,1); (c) a curve with low points at x=-2 and x=2 and a high point at x=0; (d) a log-like curve that only rises.
